political_group.name: Group of the European People's Party (Christian Democrats)

paragraphs.text: Mr President, the Middle East is disintegrating while the EU's role is that of a bystander. Ceasefires are not working, and there are new fronts and more violence. Today the Houthis – and it has been said today, we're very happy to know that the Council is already speaking about this – are advancing now and they are very close to controlling the Bab al Mandab. The situation is extremely serious, as this is the only alternative route to the Strait of Hormuz and poses a threat to security, peace our ASPIDES missions and global trade. I proposed a debate on the escalation of the issue and also to add the Houthis to the EU's terrorism list, but it was not widely supported. So now I think that with the decision of the Council, maybe we can bring it to this next Strasbourg plenary.

High Representative, you have been talking about Middle East strategies for months. We are still waiting. If we want to have political leverage in the region, we need a strategy that is anticipatory rather than reactive. For that, we need a strong European External Action Service and for that you have our full support. But we also need you to lead in defending international law, the International Criminal Court, for the fight against terrorism and the two‑state solution. We need security, peace and dignity without occupation.

paragraphs.text: Signor Presidente, onorevoli colleghi, da generazioni, da quasi 100 generazioni, questo conflitto non conosce soluzione di discontinuità. Da oltre 2000 anni, cambiano gli eserciti, cambiano i governi, cambiano le armi, ma il risultato è sempre lo stesso: mostri, morti, distruzione, odio.

E allora, dobbiamo avere il coraggio di dirlo: se dopo così tante generazioni, ebrei e arabi palestinesi non sono riusciti a costruire la pace da soli, non possiamo continuare ad aspettare che siano soltanto loro a farlo.

La pace deve essere internazionalizzata. Questo è il vero caso dove è utile attuare un cordone sanitario. La comunità internazionale deve assumersi la responsabilità di costruire e garantire una soluzione. E l'Europa deve smettere di limitarsi a criticare le crisi ma deve iniziare a costruire le condizioni di pace.
Non dobbiamo scegliere quale dei due popoli abbia più ragione. Dobbiamo scegliere la pace, costruire le condizioni perché entrambi possono vivere in sicurezza.
Continuare ad aspettare che questa guerra si esaurisca da sola significa soltanto consegnarla alla prossima generazione.

paragraphs.text: Monsieur le Président, oui, tout va mal, très mal au Proche-Orient. Mais l'Iran ne peut pas tenir ainsi, les États-Unis non plus. Et quand ils auront voté, Israéliens et Palestiniens devront chercher les moyens de sortir de cette épouvantable impasse.

C'est donc le moment de nous faire entendre, nous les Européens, de proposer les voies d'un compromis dans le Golfe et de redire l'évidence, de marteler qu'il n'y a pas d'autre solution que la solution à deux États pour que coexistent deux peuples qui se disputent une même terre. Nous ne sommes ni pro-israéliens, ni pro-palestiniens. Nous sommes pro-paix, mais alors, disons-le.

Disons-le, en décernant – beaucoup le proposent, Renew le propose – notre prix Sakharov à ces Justes, juifs et Arabes qui côte à côte, Standing Together, c'est le nom qu'ils se sont choisis, défendent l'utopie que nous avons fait triompher en Europe: celle de la paix et de la fraternité.

paragraphs.text: Mr President, four years ago today, Jina Mahsa Amini was fighting for her life in a hospital bed. She lost that fight. Since then, tens of thousands of young Iranians have been killed, imprisoned, forced into exile. Four years of uprising, of courage met with bullets, of hope met with prison cells. And yet, this generation has changed Iran, even if it has not yet changed the regime. Meanwhile, the world has moved on to oil prices and geopolitics, and Iranians have every right to ask: 'What became of all your promises?'

Dear colleagues, we may not be able to bring freedom to Iran from the outside, but we have to stand with those fighting and risking everything to win it themselves. Investigate crimes against humanity, give refuge to those most at risk, expel regime agents, fight transnational repression on European soil, fully enforce sanctions and never forget those behind bars and on death row. Freedom will come. Until it does, it is our job to stand with those fighting for it.
(The speaker concluded in a non-official language)

Καλείτε το Ιράν να σταματήσει τους βομβαρδισμούς, δεν μας λέτε, όμως, ποιος ξεκίνησε και συνεχίζει τον πόλεμο. Έχετε δώσει μέχρι στιγμής 300 δισεκατομμύρια στην Ουκρανία και επιβάλατε 20 πακέτα κυρώσεων σε βάρος της Ρωσίας. Και από την άλλη, καλείτε με πάρα πολύ ευγενικό τρόπο το Ισραήλ να σταματήσει τους εποικισμούς. Δεν πρόκειται απλά για εποικισμούς. Πρόκειται για εγκληματική συμπεριφορά και για γενοκτονία. Δεν τολμάτε να πείτε αυτή τη λέξη.

Οικοδομείται με δικαιοσύνη, διπλωματία και σεβασμό στο διεθνές δίκαιο για όλους, χωρίς εξαιρέσεις.

paragraphs.text: Herr Präsident! Der Krieg gegen den Iran wird zum Desaster. Die Führung in Teheran sitzt fest im Sattel; zuvor stand sie innenpolitisch unter Druck. Der Iran ist neue Regionalmacht im Nahen Osten; zuvor war er international isoliert. Die Militärpräsenz der USA in den Golfstaaten ist geschwächt; zuvor galt Washington dort als Sicherheitsgarant. Die mit dem Iran verbündeten Huthis kontrollieren die Rotmeerküste; zuvor stagnierten sie im Jemen. Die Straße von Hormus: dicht; das Rote Meer: dicht; vor dem Krieg: beides offen.

Der Ölpreis ist seither um 50 % gestiegen. Wir tanken bald für 3 EUR pro Liter – unzumutbar. Trotzdem kämpfen die USA und Israel weiter − einen Kampf, den sie nicht gewinnen können, einen Kampf, der in fremdem, nicht in unserem Interesse ist. Destabilisierung der Region, Flüchtlingswellen, Energiepreisschock, wirtschaftlicher Kollaps – wir tragen die Kosten für die Kriege anderer, und Sie, Frau Kallas, Sie tun nichts dagegen. Sie sind nur Zuschauer, denn verhandeln tun andere − etwa Pakistan. Die Welt ändert sich; sie wird multipolar, und leider verliert Europa den Anschluss.

paragraphs.text: Mr President, as long as the Iranian regime continues to export violence, there will be no lasting peace in the Middle East. Iran's latest missile attack on Jordanian territory is completely unacceptable. Jordan is a key partner of the European Union and the pillar of regional stability. Its sovereignty and security must be protected. For years, the mullahs have financed, armed and directed their proxies, including Hezbollah in Lebanon and the Houthis in Yemen, spreading conflicts far beyond Iran's borders. The Houthis' attacks on commercial vessels threaten freedom of navigation through the Red Sea, disrupting this vital maritime corridor. This means fewer goods reaching Europe, longer and more expensive shipping routes, and higher energy and consumer prices for our citizens.

We must protect these strategic waterways and restore freedom of navigation. And one point must remain non-negotiable: Iran must never acquire nuclear weapons. Without a firm response to Tehran, there can be no regional security, stable energy supplies or lasting peace.

paragraphs.text: Mr President, colleagues, the first time I visited Israel and Palestine was back in 2006, exactly 20 years ago. And do you know what has happened since then? Palestine has been carved into ever smaller pieces. The occupation and illegal settlements have expanded. Gaza has been carpet bombed.

And what has the EU done? Words, words and words. Where are the sanctions? Where is the ban on settlement projects? Where is the suspension of the EU‑Israel Association Agreement? Where is the arms embargo? For now, nowhere and I am ashamed.

I welcome the decision by the UK, France and Canada to ban Israeli settlement products, following the lead of Spain and Ireland. But where are the other EU Member States? How can products from something that is illegal be treated as legal? This embodies the words 'silence is complicity'.

political_group.name: Group of the Progressive Alliance of Socialists and Democrats in the European Parliament

paragraphs.text: Mr President, High Representative, Israel is making Palestinian life in the West Bank completely unviable. Cutting off water for businesses, ethnic cleansing in East Jerusalem, widespread settler violence and the bulldozing of Palestinian villages – the list goes on. It is a suffocation of Palestinian life.

But what would it mean to put an end to Palestinians right to self-determination? A one-state solution means either full Palestinian rights, which means no Jewish state, or no Palestinian rights, which means no democratic state. Any friend of Israel, anyone who aspires to the security of Palestinians and Israelis alike, must direct Israel to the correct path.
Currently, the EU is divided and isolated. Our allies in the UK and Canada show us that a principled position is possible. Banning trade with illegal settlements is the least we can do.

Last week alone, Iran attacked at least 10 merchant vessels near the Strait of Hormuz and, at the same time, the Houthis have now seized key ports and islands along the Bab al Mandab Strait.

I think the European answer is the right one. We are strengthening our relationship with the Gulf countries. Negotiations on a free trade agreement with the UAE and the strategic partnership agreement with Qatar and Bahrain are ongoing, while a comparable framework has been proposed for Saudi Arabia. paragraphs.text: Senhor Presidente, Senhora Alta Representante, caros colegas, quando pensávamos que a realidade não poderia piorar, nos últimos dias, a guerra no Médio Oriente conheceu uma nova escalada com impacto na vida dos europeus e mais sofrimento na região.

Os hutis conquistaram o controlo da costa ocidental do Iémen e uma posição privilegiada no estreito de Bab el‑Mandeb. Depois de Ormuz, o domínio da ligação entre o mar Vermelho e o golfo de Adém ameaça agora mais 12 % do trânsito de comércio mundial. E, ao mesmo tempo, o número de afetados cresce hora a hora — cerca de 100 000 pessoas deslocadas internamente no Iémen e 2 000 refugiados a entrarem no Jibuti.

Sabemos que muito do que se passa na região resulta de violações das regras de direito internacional a que a União Europeia é estranha. Mas, por isso, precisamos de mais presença diplomática nossa, europeia, para ajudar a interromper o ciclo de violência. Precisamos do reforço do apoio às nossas missões, ASPIDES e Atalanta. Mas, acima de tudo, precisamos que a voz única, consistente, a única que tem peso político próprio de acordo com os Tratados, a sua, Senhora Alta Representante, assuma esta mensagem e tenha o apoio de todos nós.

paragraphs.text: A Uachtaráin, a Ard-Ionadaí, is ábhar fíorthábhachtach conspóideach é seo.

The E1 settlement, approved by Israel for construction, will isolate Palestinian Jerusalem from the West Bank, killing any hope of a contiguous two-state solution. It is the democratic position of this Parliament, and of international law, that a two-state solution must be pursued.

For years, unfortunately, we and others did nothing as Israeli settlers displaced Palestinians without justification. We are now at a tipping point: if E1 is built, the two-state solution is dead. The EEAS condemned this only last month. But does Israel listen? No, it does not.

So we must be decisive. The EU must join UK, France and Canada's ban on trade with illegal settlers and go further: suspend the EU-Israel Association Agreement if E1 goes ahead. If we do not act now, it is too late for us, for Palestine and for any hope of peace in the future.
Is scéal tragóideach é. Bímis cróga ag iarraidh é a réiteach.

paragraphs.text: Mr President, honourable Members, thank you for this debate. It is really critical and this situation is escalating again. Our position is grounded in international law, human rights and the urgent need for peace.

First on what is happening in the Red Sea and the Strait of Hormuz: so we have the Operation ASPIDES, and my call is also for the Member States to actually give more naval vessels, because now we see that that Bab al Mandab is closed. I mean, the Operation ASPIDES – I was visiting it myself – is really escorting the ships out of this, but we need more vessels to be credible. And that is also what some said here. We are strengthening our ties to the Gulf countries. We have the Gulf Cooperation Council summit coming up. But there, if we want to be also credible security providers in the region, we really need to enforce our two operations that we have: operation Speed and Operation ASPIDES, which is also fighting with the pirates there.

On Israel and Palestine: I mean, we are firmly committed to a comprehensive, just and lasting peace based on a two-state solution, but I also agree with those who have said that considering what is going on in the West Bank and the settlements, then this two-state solution is becoming increasingly impossible to implement because little pieces are taken off. And that's why we have been also discussing different options. Unfortunately, we don't have all the Member States on board to move so that we can send a clear message that we don't accept this.

paragraphs.text: Mr President, High Representative, I have just returned from the West Bank and Israel, and let me tell you, the situation is much worse than what we have discussed today. We must clearly condemn the Hamas terrorist attacks, but we cannot turn a blind eye to the Israeli Government's response. Former Israeli soldiers described to me clear orders to intimidate Palestinian civilians and protect illegal settlers. I witnessed Israeli settlers carrying automatic weapons and threatening Palestinian civilians. I met families in East Jerusalem forced to demolish their homes with their bare hands. The policy of the Israeli Government and those who enable illegal settlements are not only immoral, not only against international law, but they also jeopardise Israel's international support and ultimately, Israel's own security.

A united European response must therefore be, at the minimum, targeted sanctions against illegal settlers and everybody who is supporting them. This must happen, and we do have the means. Qualified majority voting is possible there.

paragraphs.text: Monsieur le Président, Madame la Commissaire, Madame Kallas, aujourd'hui, la politique étrangère pour les citoyens doit être au service des citoyens en Europe.

J'ai abandonné tout espoir au niveau humanitaire, parce que quand vous n'arrivez pas à condamner le massacre d'enfants dans une école en Iran juste parce que c'est les États-Unis, ou le bombardement d'un mariage, c'est extrêmement grave – mais au moins au service des citoyens européens. Aujourd'hui, à la pompe, on va payer trois euros le litre. Trois euros. Pour le gaz, nos réserves n'arrivent pas à se remplir. On est dans une situation horrible.

Et à la base de tout cela se trouve l'attaque illégale des États-Unis contre l'Iran, qui ensuite a fait effet boule de neige: fermeture du détroit d'Ormuz, ensuite, réaction des Houthis contre l'Arabie Saoudite avec une potentielle fermeture aussi du Bab-el-Mandeb.

Et que fait l'Union européenne? Où est-elle? Aucune initiative diplomatique. Essayez, au moins, d'être crédible. Condamnez les États-Unis, dites que c'est eux le problème. Mais vous, dans votre discours, vous ne mentionnez même pas les États-Unis. Comment est-ce possible?

Foarte bine, sunt mai puternici de o mie de ori decât voi și au renunțat să mai plătească în euro sau în dolari până când Europa va cădea și se va alege praful. Chiar nu înțelegeți că greșiți în politica dumneavoastră?

paragraphs.text: Κύριε Πρόεδρε, η συνεχιζόμενη κλιμάκωση στη Μέση Ανατολή απειλεί ολόκληρη την περιοχή. Όσοι θεωρούν ότι η Ευρώπη βρίσκεται μακριά, σφάλλουν. Το ανατολικότερο άκρο της Ευρώπης, η Κύπρος, βρίσκεται μια ανάσα από το πεδίο των μαχών, στην πρώτη γραμμή μιας εξαιρετικά ασταθούς περιοχής. Αμερικανοί αξιωματούχοι ήδη προειδοποιούν για πραγματικό κίνδυνο περιφερειακής κλιμάκωσης. Η αντιπαράθεση έχει αποκτήσει στρατιωτική διάσταση μεταξύ Τουρκίας και Ισραήλ σε ξηρά, θάλασσα και αέρα, καθώς και σε πολιτικό επίπεδο, μέσω ανταλλαγής σκληρών δηλώσεων. Το Ισραήλ έθεσε σαφή «κόκκινη γραμμή» την τουρκική παρουσία στη Συρία. Αν η Τουρκία επιλέξει την πάγια τακτική, να κλιμακώσει τις εντάσεις μέσω των Κατεχομένων της Κύπρου, η Ευρώπη πώς θα αντιδράσει;

Ας το κατανοήσουν όλοι. Το πρόβλημα της Ευρώπης δεν είναι μόνο η Ρωσία. Η προστασία των κρατών της Ευρώπης ξεκινά και από την Κύπρο. Η Ευρώπη οφείλει, επιτέλους, να αναλάβει τις ευθύνες της. Δεν μπορεί να υπάρξει ασφάλεια στην Ευρώπη όσο ευρωπαϊκό έδαφος παραμένει υπό κατοχή, όσο η Κύπρος δεν είναι ελεύθερη.

paragraphs.text: Senhor Presidente, Senhora Kaja Kallas, a senhora confunde muitas palavras e eu queria propor‑lhe algumas correções. Não há partes num conflito entre os Estados Unidos e o Irão — há uma agressão dos Estados Unidos ao Irão. Não há um arco de instabilidade no Médio Oriente — há uma desestabilização do Médio Oriente deliberadamente provocada pelos Estados Unidos e por Israel, com o apoio cúmplice da União Europeia. Não há ataques indiscriminados do Irão aos seus vizinhos — há a retaliação iraniana aos ataques americanos, numa escalada de guerra que foi imposta e é da responsabilidade de Trump e de Netanyahu em toda a região.

Na Palestina, a ação dos colonos não é o único problema. Há também, e sobretudo, o problema da política do Estado de Israel, o apartheid imposto por Israel com a sua política racista, genocida, desumana, que, de forma sistemática e metódica, inviabiliza as condições de vida dos palestinianos na Cisjordânia e assassina os mesmos palestinianos na Faixa de Gaza, incluindo crianças, que são sujeitas a todo o tipo de violência.

paragraphs.text: Mr President, 47 years of conflict and terror in the Middle East, planned by the Islamic Republic. From funding terrorism to slaughtering Iranians.

But once the US and Israel started bombing this source of terror, the EU panicked. You immediately started talking about the urgent need for a way out of the conflict. Hasn't there been an urgent need for that for 47 years already?

The strikes against the Islamic regime have been the first credible way out of the decades‑long bloodshed. We must understand that the longer this Islamic regime exists, the longer it will take for peace and stability to return the region and the whole world.
Instead of diplomacy, this regime deserves a cocktail of isolation, sanctions and the sound of bombs dropping.

paragraphs.text: Domnule președinte, am votat categoric împotriva CBAM, mecanismului european de ajustare a carbonului la frontieră, deoarece este o suprataxă care va crește și mai mult costurile de producție în Europa, ceea ce va slăbi economia și competitivitatea europeană, cu efect direct în sărăcirea populației.

Acest CBAM scumpește oțelul, cimentul, aluminiul și îngrășămintele. Costurile cad pe industrie, pe fermier și, la final, pe fiecare consumator. Familiile vor plăti și mai mult pentru locuințe, alimente și bunuri de bază, în timp ce inflația va crește.

Nu poți să protejezi industria europeană făcând producția în Europa tot mai scumpă, iar produsele europene tot mai greu de vândut. Companiile europene rămân dezavantajate pe piețele externe, unde concurenții nu plătesc astfel de taxe aberante.

Această măsură nu reduce emisiile globale, ci crește prețurile și birocrația în Europa la niveluri nemaiîntâlnite. Firmele vor trebui să documenteze emisiile de carbon din lanțurile de producție complexe din întreaga lume. IMM-urile vor fi copleșite de costuri administrative și raportări imposibile. În loc să se focalizeze pe producție, firmele din Europa vor trebui să cântărească aerul. Opriți această nebunie!

paragraphs.text: Κύριε Πρόεδρε, οι αναθεώρησης του CBAM, του ETS, του Ταμείου Απανθρακοποίησης επιβεβαιώνουν ότι η επιδίωξη της πράσινης μετάβασης ήταν να ενισχύσει τα μονοπώλια με πακτωλούς χρημάτων στον σκληρό ανταγωνισμό με Κίνα και ΗΠΑ, και ο λαός να πληρώνει τον λογαριασμό με πανάκριβη ενέργεια και καύσιμα. Σήμερα, μπροστά στην κλιμάκωση των πολεμικών μετώπων σε Ουκρανία και Μέση Ανατολή, τη διαφαινόμενη καπιταλιστική κρίση, επιστρατεύετε δωρεάν δικαιώματα ρύπανσης, εξαιρέσεις, ταμεία στήριξης για τους ομίλους πληρωμένα από το υστέρημα των εργαζομένων. Μεθοδεύετε μάλιστα το ETS 2 με νέα χαράτσια έως και 800 ευρώ για τη θέρμανση των σπιτιών μας, στο αυτοκίνητο, στις μετακινήσεις. Θα προστεθούν αυτά στην ακρίβεια του ρεύματος εξαιτίας της απελευθέρωσης του χρηματιστηρίου ενέργειας, της απολιγνιτοποίησης και της στροφής στο πανάκριβο αμερικάνικο LNG. Τα κέρδη των πράσινων ομίλων υπηρετούν η Ευρωπαϊκή Ένωση, οι κυβερνήσεις και όλα τα κόμματα του κεφαλαίου, την ώρα που οι λαοί πληρώνουν την ενεργειακή ακρίβεια, τους πολεμικούς και ενεργειακούς ανταγωνισμούς. Είναι τρανή απόδειξη ότι, για να κερδίσει ο λαός, πρέπει να χάσει το κεφάλαιο.

paragraphs.text: Señor presidente, la aprobación del Reglamento relativo al Mecanismo de Ajuste en Frontera por Carbono es un paso adelante que garantiza seguridad jurídica y combate la elusión al compromiso europeo —que es firme— contra la emergencia climática y por la descarbonización de la economía.

Pero esta mañana se ha aprobado también una enmienda de los eurodiputados procedentes de regiones ultraperiféricas que genera una flexibilización en su artículo 12 con respecto a los productos importados en las regiones ultraperiféricas no sujetos a transformación respecto de ningún otro destino y que sean consumidos localmente.

Esto es una aplicación de la base jurídica exclusiva del artículo 349 del Tratado de la Unión Europea y significa no solamente sensibilidad con las regiones ultraperiféricas —que son Europa, plenamente— sino un cumplimiento anticipatorio de la estrategia de regiones ultraperiféricas que hemos conocido este mismo 10 de septiembre gracias a una Comunicación de la Comisión, que se compromete a que toda la regulación contemplará la singularidad de los territorios alejados y fragmentados que son regiones ultraperiféricas, como Canarias.

interventions.text:
Señor presidente, la aprobación del Reglamento relativo al Mecanismo de Ajuste en Frontera por Carbono es un paso adelante que garantiza seguridad jurídica y combate la elusión al compromiso europeo —que es firme— contra la emergencia climática y por la descarbonización de la economía.

Pero esta mañana se ha aprobado también una enmienda de los eurodiputados procedentes de regiones ultraperiféricas que genera una flexibilización en su artículo 12 con respecto a los productos importados en las regiones ultraperiféricas no sujetos a transformación respecto de ningún otro destino y que sean consumidos localmente.

Esto es una aplicación de la base jurídica exclusiva del artículo 349 del Tratado de la Unión Europea y significa no solamente sensibilidad con las regiones ultraperiféricas —que son Europa, plenamente— sino un cumplimiento anticipatorio de la estrategia de regiones ultraperiféricas que hemos conocido este mismo 10 de septiembre gracias a una Comunicación de la Comisión, que se compromete a que toda la regulación contemplará la singularidad de los territorios alejados y fragmentados que son regiones ultraperiféricas, como Canarias.

paragraphs.text: Domnule președinte, am votat împotriva ETS2 sau schema UE de comercializare a certificatelor de emisii de gaze cu efect de seră, deoarece această măsură promovată de Ursula von der Leyen jefuiește românii și europenii.

ETS2 pune un preț pe carbon pentru gazul folosit la încălzire și pentru benzină și motorină, ceea ce va conduce la un alt val de scumpiri ale prețurilor. Factura la gaze va crește, toate produsele se vor scumpi pentru că necesită transport, iar deplasările zilnice ale europenilor vor deveni mai scumpe.

Cei mai afectați vor fi pensionarii, familiile cu venituri mici, locuitorii din mediul rural și tinerii care trebuie să facă naveta la muncă. Dacă producția pleacă din Europa, Comisia nu rezolvă problema emisiilor, ci doar alungă locurile de muncă în alte părți, în timp ce pe europenii îi sărăcește.

Este inadmisibil ca Bruxelles să impună asemenea experimente ideologice neomarxiste pe seama bunăstării cetățenilor europeni. Europa are nevoie de energie ieftină, de industrie puternică și de birocratizare. Pentru asta trebuie să scape de Ursula von der Leyen cât mai repede.

paragraphs.text: Κύριε Πρόεδρε, στο επικίνδυνο πλαίσιο της πολεμικής ετοιμότητας και εμπλοκής, η Ευρωπαϊκή Ένωση και οι κυβερνήσεις δημιουργούν έναν πολυπλόκαμο μηχανισμό χειραγώγησης, κατασκοπείας και χαφιεδισμού, την ψευδεπίγραφη ασπίδα δημοκρατίας. Στόχος η σιγή νεκροταφείου στους τόπους δουλειάς, με πλύση εγκεφάλου στα ΜΜΕ, σχολεία και πανεπιστήμια, στον πολιτισμό. Επιδιώκουν το ελεύθερο για όσα και το Ευρωπαϊκό Κοινοβούλιο ζητάει: χτυπήματα σε υποδομές, κλιμάκωση της σύγκρουσης —πολεμικής και εμπορικής—, με Ρωσία-Κίνα στον μεταξύ τους ανταγωνισμό. Καταδίκη όσων αμφισβητούν την αντιλαϊκή στρατηγική της Ευρωπαϊκής Ένωσης στη λογική «όποιος διαφωνεί είναι ξένος πράκτορας». Ενίσχυση κατασταλτικών αστυνομικών μηχανισμών. Δημιουργία κέντρου πρακτορείου δήθεν δημοκρατικής ανθεκτικότητας.

Τέτοια μέτρα πρωτίστως χτυπούν τον αγώνα των εργαζομένων, σέρνουν αγωνιστές στα δικαστήρια. Επικαλείται η Ευρωπαϊκή Ένωση τρομοκρατία και αυταρχικά καθεστώτα, ενώ η ίδια συνδιαλέγεται μαζί τους όταν υπηρετούνται τα συμφέροντα των ομίλων. Οι εργαζόμενοι να απορρίψουν με την πάλη τους την πολεμική φρενίτιδα, τη δικτατορία του κεφαλαίου. Να αγωνιστούν για τις σύγχρονες ανάγκες. Απεμπλοκή από ιμπεριαλιστικούς σχεδιασμούς, αποδέσμευση από κάθε ιμπεριαλιστική συμμαχία, με τον λαό στην εξουσία.
